fa_declaration.summary.title: {season} KBO FA filing window closes
fa_declaration.summary.body:
The KBO FA filing window for the {season} season has closed. {declared_count} players chose to enter the market, while {deferred_count} eligible players stayed with their original clubs for now.

The first shape of the market will come from the top graded names, positional scarcity and how aggressively clubs want to replace production already on the roster.

Notable FA filers
{declared_list}
Notable players who deferred
{deferred_list}
Players who deferred generally did so after weighing the market against the security of staying put.

fa_declaration.retry.title.v1: {player_name} delays FA filing for another run
fa_declaration.retry.title.v2: {player_name} passes on KBO FA market for now
fa_declaration.retry.body:
{player_link} of {team_link} has decided not to file for free agency this time. The eligibility was there, but the player chose one more season to rebuild leverage before entering the market.

The Grade {grade} candidate stays with his original club for now. For the team, it preserves a familiar roster piece; for the player, the next FA window now depends on turning the coming season into a stronger platform.

fa_declaration.retry.body.v2:
{player_link} will not be part of the {season} KBO FA market. After weighing recent form and likely demand, he will remain with {team_link} and try to improve his position before filing.

The decision keeps him out of this year's FA class, but it also leaves the door open for a cleaner market entry later.
